description: "Town and Country Sermons" by Charles Kingsley is a collection of sermons written in the mid-19th century. This work reflects Kingsley’s insights and teachings, primarily focusing on Christian faith, moral conduct, and the significance of obedience to God—particularly as articulated in the context of Passion Week.
